scope: Frozen shared Web/EXE source only; no application build, deployment, live server or client acceptance.

checks.name: typecheck
checks.command: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json --noEmit }

checks.name: lint
checks.command: node ../../node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js src/App.tsx src/api.ts src/project-drafts.ts src/pending-submission.ts src/pending-submission.test.ts src/project-drafts.test.ts --max-warnings=0

checks.name: format
checks.command: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check apps/web/src/App.tsx apps/web/src/api.ts apps/web/src/project-drafts.ts apps/web/src/pending-submission.ts apps/web/src/pending-submission.test.ts apps/web/src/project-drafts.test.ts

implemented: Frozen Bug/comment business identity and complete core JSON before request; same scope and original intent on unknown outcome
Durable attachment File/hash/identity and init/chunk/finalize/bind checkpoints; equal current chunk version replay accepted
Strict IndexedDB write commit before subsequent effect; uncommitted writes excluded from in-memory cache
Unacknowledged successful receipts remain explicitly confirmable, including beside deliberately blank newer drafts; edited text/files retained
Definite rejection evidence retained before explicit atomic replacement; prior unknown/concurrent core attempts and 401/403/409/5xx never release an intent

definiteRejectionPolicy.upload: HTTP400 UPLOAD_CONTENT_INVALID/INVALID_REQUEST only while durable core commitAttempts=0
definiteRejectionPolicy.core: HTTP400 INVALID_REQUEST only first uncontended attempt=1 and durable current count still1; server parsing/adapter ordering reviewed
definiteRejectionPolicy.release: Explicit user action rechecks the same rejection ID; retains original files, request, checkpoints and rejection

limitations: Fetch responses and response-loss conditions are local test doubles, not a real HTTP service or installed client.

IndexedDB commit/abort tests use a controlled event boundary and pending-journal tests use a serialized storage adapter. They do not prove physical browser storage durability or a native browser/EXE process restart.
No real Web/EXE failure injection, upgrade or end-to-end acceptance was performed here.
No schema/queue cleanup, automatic unknown-intent abandonment or blanket 4xx retry reset was introduced.
